title: Buena Vista | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Steps from Beach | Private Pool | Pet & Event Friendly – Buena Vista by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Buena Vista by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 38 Santa Clara Street Details: Step into pure coastal bliss at this Seagrove Beach vacation rental, where every detail is designed for unforgettable 30A vacations. Just 262 feet from the Santa Clara Regional Beach Access (featuring restrooms, ADA access, and seasonal lifeguards), you’ll have the Gulf at your doorstep. With a large private heated pool, Buena Vista’s backyard is perfect for long afternoons in the sun. Inside, an elevator makes every floor accessible. Head up to the fourth-floor tower and observation deck to toast the sunset with breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico. Great shopping and delicious restaurants at Seaside and Greenway Station are just a short bike ride away! Buena Vista is both event-friendly and pet-friendly, making it a top choice among pet friendly 30A rentals for families and groups who want to bring their four-legged friends along. For those searching for 30A vacation rentals with private pool, Seagrove Beach rentals, or simply the best in 30A vacation rentals, this home is the perfect match. Don’t wait! Your dream Seagrove Beach getaway is ready. Book now and make your next 30A trip unforgettable! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Santa Clara Regional Beach Access: 262 Feet (1-Minute Walk): The beach access offers parking, restrooms, ADA accessibility, and lifeguards in peak season. - Distance to Seaside: 1.6 Miles (9-Minute Bike Ride) - Distance to Greenway Station: 1.3 Miles (7-Minute Bike Ride) - Pet Friendly with approval ($350 each, pre-tax; must prearrange with Reservations) - Large Private Heated Pool ($330 pre-tax; 24-hour heat-up; must prearrange with Reservations) - Elevator - Event-Friendly (For An Additional Fee) - Parking: 5 Spaces in Driveway + 2-Car Garage - Dining: Table Seating for 12–14, Bar Seating for 5–6 - Coffee Maker Available - Propane Grill Available Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 27 7 Bedrooms / 7 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1: 2 Sets of Twin/Twin Bunks with Twin Trundle, 1 Full/Full Bunk with Twin Trundle (Sleeps 11) with Shared Bath (Shower) -Living room -Game room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 5: Twin/Full/Twin Bunk with Private Bath Third Floor: -Bedroom 6: Queen Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 7: Two Full Beds with Shared Bath -Laundry Room Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- We found Buena Vista to be the perfect home for our large family and friends who love spending time at the beach. With three floors, seven bedrooms, seven bathrooms, two living rooms, and a spacious kitchen and dining area, it meets all our needs. The numerous windows and patio doors let in tons of natural light, and our favorite spot to relax is the large balcony off the upper living area. Some bedrooms also have private balconies, perfect for reading or unwinding. We recently renovated two bathrooms with stunning marble tile, walk-in showers, and modern fixtures. The oversized pool is perfect for laps, and the private, fenced backyard is a bonus. Just a short walk to the beach, we also love taking long oceanfront walks. The home’s elevator adds convenience, and the first floor has a separate living room, large bunk room, and game room—great for our younger guests.
